notes:
Alerts after a read you start.

- Arbitrage has an Alerts setting: a minimum edge for +EV bets, a minimum locked return for arbs, which kinds, and Recommended plays only or all. After a refresh you start, a play that is new since the last read and meets it is marked New and named in a banner.
- Turn on Mac notification and the same line is posted as a notification. macOS lists it under Script Editor, so you may need to allow it in System Settings.
- Alerts never read prices by themselves: nothing runs on a timer, and nothing is sent anywhere.
